title: RAY 全局清单
content:
# 全局基础设施 v3.1 — 2026-05-01

## EC2
- nexhub360-sg / 18.140.142.3 / t3.large 8GB
- ✅ 4G swap 已加 (/swapfile2, fstab 持久化)
- npm run build 不再 OOM

## 工具链
- ✅ git/Node/npm/pm2/docker/curl/jq
- ❌ gh CLI 未装,PR 走 GitHub UI 手动开

## Conductor API (2026-05-01 实测)
- PUT /state/<slug>:JSON body {content}
- POST /rules:form-urlencoded(不是 JSON)
- POST /rules/<id>/delete:无 body

## 终端坑
- Termius/WSL markdown 把 URL/var 加链接吞内容
- heredoc 多行 Promise<...> 会被吞 → 用 Python 写文件

## 域名
- nexhub360.com (prod) / dev.nexhub360.com (dev) / conductor.rayaihq.com / rsport8.com
  - ⚠️ **nexhub360.com nginx 退役未完成**（asof 2026-05-01）:仍 `root /home/ubuntu/nexhub-vue/dist`,待切 `proxy_pass http://localhost:3300` (nh-xiaor)
  - verify: `sudo nginx -T 2>/dev/null | grep -A2 "server_name nexhub360" | head -5`

## PM2
- nh-xiaor (prod 3300, 跑 8fb0696) / nh-xiaor-dev / nh-tgbot / nh-cron / nh-intel-api / bot-mega888 / bot-wm789

## 状态更正（asof 2026-05-01 收工）
- nexhub-vue nginx 已切换到 Next.js (server_name nexhub360.com 已 proxy_pass :3300, Vue dist 早废, 之前 mirror 字段过时), verify: sudo nginx -T 2>/dev/null | grep -A1 "server_name nexhub360"
- npm run build 实测 4G swap 后不 OOM, worktree 根 CLAUDE.md 旧禁令需更新(保留 pm2 stop 释放内存的警告,但不再绝对禁), docs/CLAUDE.md 同步
